title: Cross-Doc Morphs, Peel Decks, Hanging Type, Precision Lock & Auto-Contrast
description: Five 2026 platform-native drops: cross-document view transitions, a scroll-driven card peel, hanging-punctuation type, Pointer Lock 2.0, and contrast-color().

drops.title: Cross-Doc Morph
drops.description: Three real, separately-navigable pages share a morphing hero plate, headline and nav pill across genuine page loads.
drops.concept: Uses the newly cross-browser @view-transition { navigation: auto; } at-rule to run a View Transition across actual multi-page navigation — no SPA router, no JS orchestrating the animation. Matching view-transition-name values on the hero art, title and active nav pill let the browser interpolate them across three linked HTML documents.
drops.source: MDN & Chrome for Developers — Cross-Document View Transitions

interaction.mouse: click a nav pill to navigate between pages
interaction.click: navigate + tune duration/easing in the panel

drops.title: Sticky Peel Deck
drops.description: Six cards pin in place and peel away one by one as you scroll, each on its own view() timeline.
drops.concept: A 2026-trending 'layered card stack' pattern: each card sits inside a sticky panel and animates purely via animation-timeline: view() with a per-card animation-range, so the peel is entirely scroll-linked with zero JavaScript scroll listeners.
drops.source: MDN CSS Scroll-Driven Animations guide + 2026 sticky-card-stack pattern
tech: CSS custom properties for live tuning

interaction.mouse: scroll to flip through the stack
interaction.click: adjust peel angle & stagger in the panel
interaction.touch: scroll/swipe to flip through the stack

drops.title: Editorial Broadsheet
drops.description: An oversized viewport-scaled headline paired with native hanging-punctuation on three pull-quotes.
drops.concept: 2026's editorial-typography trend — huge, negative-space-driven headlines — paired with the quieter native CSS property hanging-punctuation, which pushes leading/trailing quote glyphs outside the text measure the way print typesetting always has. A toggle lets you compare hung vs. un-hung punctuation directly.

interaction.mouse: toggle hanging punctuation, drag the headline scale slider

drops.title: Precision Lock
drops.description: An aim-trainer, a fine-tune dial and an infinite draw pad, all driven by raw Pointer Lock deltas.
drops.concept: Demonstrates the Promise-based Pointer Lock 2.0 API: click to lock the cursor to the stage and drive three different controls with unclamped movementX/Y deltas that never hit a screen edge — with a graceful unlocked-mouse fallback when lock is unsupported or denied.
drops.source: W3C Pointer Lock 2.0 spec & MDN Pointer Lock API

interaction.mouse: engage lock, then move anywhere to drive the active mode
interaction.touch: drag inside the stage (lock is desktop-only)

drops.title: Auto-Contrast Badges
drops.description: Badges, buttons and alert banners that recompute their own readable text color live via contrast-color().
drops.concept: The new CSS contrast-color() function picks black or white automatically for the highest-contrast readable text against any background. Dragging the hue slider repaints every badge, button and banner with a fresh set of backgrounds, all instantly readable — with a JS relative-luminance fallback for browsers that don't support the function yet.
